heading: ⚠️ WHEN THE `motir-plan` SKILL IS NOT AVAILABLE — trigger motir-ai with the WHAT, or park, comment and STOP
The CLOSE-OUT SWEEP — start of every `motir run` / `motir next` (`motir mark <id> done` is DEPRECATED)
A RUN ASSIGNS THE CARD TO THE USER WHO STARTED IT — and ONE claim door does not do it for you
PR titles drive the status sync — NO LONGER: the LINK does, and the title is not even a FALLBACK
⚠️ YOUR CI WENT RED — MERGE THE BASE FIRST, then fix what the log NAMED and PUSH. **The push IS the verification**
The how-to-test rule — every UI-touching feature PR states how to test it, and the RUN writes it onto its RUN TARGET
⚠️ A RECORDED DEVIATION that names an OPEN defect is a `bug` to FILE — never a paragraph
`motir run <parent>` — run a container ONE LAYER above leaves (one commit per child)
